rules.visibility: public only; never user provider responses
rules.identity: namespaced strings; no name-only identity merge
rules.qualification: source assertions are not verified dietary suitability
rules.recipes: manual review required before automatic planning/cooking
rules.commercial: BYOC, account and contract scope; no public promotion by default
rules.ownershipOrigin: dated evidence required; barcode prefix does not prove origin
rules.publication: immutable indexed release; all sources reconciled before manifest activation

world-recipes.scope: Complete acquired source files; only recipes with ingredient and instruction sections admitted. All source text remains locally retained. No inferred servings, density conversions, translations, country assignments or diet certifications. Historical rights-unresolved candidates retained separately.
world-recipes.license: Per-recipe CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0, Unlicense and documented historical original rights; attribution and share-alike retained
world-recipes.attribution: Original recipe publishers and contributors; each record carries its own attribution
world-recipes.rights: Original source licence/attribution retained; no private provider results

curatedAcceptance.limitation: All-record structural and synthetic consumer checks do not establish independently reviewed food matches or dietary qualification.

library.privacy: Pantry ingredient and quantity matching is performed locally in the browser; no pantry data is sent to publishers.
library.rights: Per-record licences and attribution govern reuse. CC BY-SA derivatives retain share-alike. No pictures or raw source archives are distributed.
